name: qh-tracker quality-lane DOM and module contract
purpose: The interface every candidate must keep (or change only by an explicit, root-approved contract amendment) so that the quality lane's independent tests stay valid. Tests key on these hooks, not on styling or class names not listed here.

baseline.manifest: BASELINE.json (13 files, all sha256 verified 2026-11-16 in this worktree)
baseline.baseline_audit: PASS, 0 failures, 2502 formulae, 0 TeX errors, 281 statements (checked 197, open 74, conditional 6, published 4), 160 grid cells

atlas: new atlas modules and the reader-safe atlas data projection

page_invariants.single_file: one self-contained HTML file; no <link rel=stylesheet|preload|preconnect|dns-prefetch>; every src/href/url() is data:, #fragment or the site's own relative home link; canonical link is never requested
page_invariants.csp_meta_exact: default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; font-src data:; img-src data:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
page_invariants.public_safety_whole_document: no content.json `source` value or fragment of it, no /Users/ or ~/ path, no repository-internal path (engine/, frontier/, attack-heal, wave-N, campaign), no 40- or 64-hex hash, no model/tool/session name, no process/version/draft/phase/wave language, no progress or closure percentage — checked over the WHOLE HTML (attributes, scripts, JSON blocks, metadata), not only visible text
page_invariants.landmarks: exactly one <main id=main tabindex=-1>; a.skip[href='#main'] is the first focusable element; nav.nav[aria-label] in the bar; footer.foot
page_invariants.theme: html[data-theme=light|dark] set from localStorage key 'qh-theme' before first paint; without it the page follows prefers-color-scheme

patterns.statement: s-<ident(statement.id)>  (only statements with an id; ident() = NFKD, ascii, [\w\s-] kept, lowercased, runs of space/_/- to '-', first 60 chars)
patterns.question: q-<ident(question.id or title or index)>

stable_anchors.rule: An anchor that exists in the baseline for a given content id must resolve to the same content item in a candidate built from the same content. Removing or renaming an anchor pattern is a contract amendment, not a refactor.

data_hooks.statement: article.statement[data-status in statement statuses] with .status-chip text = page.json status_labels[status]
data_hooks.cell: td.cell[data-status in cell statuses] > button.cell-btn[data-row=row-...][aria-label='<row name>, <column name>: <status label>']
data_hooks.marks: svg.mark.mark-<status with spaces as ->; each status a distinct shape; a mark that carries meaning has a text equivalent nearby or role=img + aria-label
data_hooks.grid: table.grid inside .grid-wrap[role=region][tabindex=0][aria-label]; thead th > button.col-head[data-col][aria-describedby=col-<id>]; tbody th[scope=row] > a[href=#row-...]
data_hooks.tally: nav.tally a[href='#examples'][data-filter=<statement status>] with .count = number of statements of that status on the whole page
data_hooks.expand: button[data-expand=all|none] act within their own section
data_hooks.card: #card[role=dialog] (non-modal) with aria-labelledby/aria-describedby set while shown; trigger aria-expanded mirrors visibility
data_hooks.search_mount: optional [data-find] element with data-label-* words; otherwise status.js inserts .find[role=search] after main > .tally
data_hooks.math: every TeX segment in reader data becomes one <math> whose <annotation encoding='application/x-tex'> equals the TeX source; display formulae in .math-display, long inline formulae in .math-long; no code.tex-error

params.q: search words (folded, every word must occur, quoted phrase)
params.in: comma list of section ids among results, decisive, frontier, examples, failures, open, essay, terms
params.status: comma list of statement statuses for search
params.show: comma list of statement statuses for the example-row filter

url_contract.hash: #<stable anchor>; on arrival and on hashchange the target's closed <details> ancestors open and a filter hiding it is lifted
url_contract.history: search/filter edits use replaceState (no new entries); following a search result to a target creates an entry; Back restores the prior search state from the address (popstate)

print_contract: beforeprint opens every main details and afterprint restores each; print hides bar, skip, theme, card, find, row tools, filters, hints, cell notes; filtered-out row statements print; formulae are never clipped; A4 and Letter

atlas_testability_requirements.data: the reader-safe atlas projection, if embedded, appears once as <script type='application/json' id='qh-atlas-data'> (not executed under the CSP) or is fully recoverable from DOM data attributes; it carries no source paths, hashes, private ids or audit logistics
atlas_testability_requirements.nodes: each rendered claim: [data-claim-id] with data-status-code in checked|conditional|scoped_negative|remaining and a visible text status label; claim ids deep-linkable by a stable anchor
atlas_testability_requirements.edges: each rendered relation: [data-edge-id][data-source][data-target][data-relation]; every rendered edge id exists in the data and its endpoints/relation match it exactly; no edge is drawn that the data lacks; direction is preserved
atlas_testability_requirements.paths: each reading path: [data-path-id][data-path-kind=editorial_orientation|source_bound_dependency_path]; a source_bound_dependency_path must have, for each consecutive stage pair, at least one data edge between their claims; editorial paths are labelled editorial in visible text
atlas_testability_requirements.equivalent: every relation shown graphically is also available as text (list or table) reachable by keyboard and named for screen readers; the graph is not the only route to any claim
atlas_testability_requirements.no_inference: no closure percentage, theorem count framed as progress, or status implied by colour alone

candidate_delivery_to_quality.request: For each candidate, root supplies a frozen manifest: candidate id, lane, list of {path, before_sha256, after_sha256} for every changed file, the unified diff or the full after-files, and the content/essay hashes used. Place it under materials/processed/qh-attack-heal-20261116/quality/inbox/<candidate-id>/ in this worktree or give an absolute path to a frozen snapshot. Quality verifies the before hashes against BASELINE.json, applies to a private mirror under quality/, builds into quality/, and reports per-check results.
candidate_delivery_to_quality.quality_does_not: poll live edits, read other lanes' unfrozen trees, or write outside quality/

acceptance_checks: EVAL-PLAN.md in this folder lists the precommitted checks (Q-ids), commands and pass thresholds.

frozen_quality_candidate.manifest: heal/MANIFEST.json sha256 0d49eaf26fa7ef21e111d2ecc47c010c07fdb33a8d220cd4b748b42b8c3c5efe (before/after sha256 for each of the 13 baseline files; 7 changed)
frozen_quality_candidate.guard: heal/apply-guarded.sh <root> [foundation|interaction|all]: refuses on any before-hash mismatch, verifies every after-hash

new_hooks.bar_search_opener: button.find-open[data-find-open] in .bar, emitted hidden; the script shows it when the search exists
new_hooks.card_close: #card > template.card-close-template holds the Close control (inert: not in the document); the script imports it as #card > button.card-close when it wires the click, and shows a Close control emitted hidden
new_hooks.filter_count: .row-tools > p.filter-count[role=status]: rendered while empty; visually hidden (still announced) while no filter is on
new_hooks.row_count_while_filtered: summary .row-count[data-count] first text node reads "<shown> of <N statements>"; full count restored for print
new_hooks.search_scopes: adds programme (lead) and status (key) scopes; section headings and introductions are searchable
new_hooks.optional_ids: content open[].id and glossary[].id give #open-<id> and #term-<id>; explicit ids are reserved and duplicates fail the build
new_hooks.row_mix_while_filtered: summary .row-count .mix gets the hidden attribute while a filter is on; print shows it with full counts
new_hooks.nav_overflow: .nav gets class nav-overflow while more links lie to the right (scrollLeft + clientWidth < scrollWidth - 1) and nav-overflow-start while links lie to the left (scrollLeft > 1), checked on load, resize, the nav's scroll, fonts ready and after the search opener appears; the CSS fades 28 px at each such edge

frozen_quality_candidate.text_form: Attributes and titles carry a formula as text with its structure: base_sub, base^sup, (num)/(den), √x (C_2, T^2, q^(1/2)); never TeX. Column names, short labels and the essay title may contain TeX and are set as mathematics.
frozen_quality_candidate.audit_surfaces: Visible text (as written and tag-spaced), formula text (mtext, multi-letter names, single-letter runs, token text), TeX source, svg text, SVG images in data: URIs in any attribute or style sheet, every non-technical attribute in either quoting, every non-JS script as data, JS strings and comments (template interpolations read as code), CSS generated content, every CSS string and comments, all non-technical metas, the title and ids. Private repository paths are checked against sha256 digests, so the producer names none.

combined_qa_procedure.note: Run on root's exact integrated candidate with the final content payload, from a copy in quality/, without writing outside quality/. A check that cannot run is reported as not run. The 11:20 atlas and the current content are only the preserved review and layout baseline.
combined_qa_procedure.static: QH_JSDOM=<jsdom> node quality/lead/qh-static.mjs --html <preview> --content <candidate content dir> --baseline_manifest quality/BASELINE.json --baseline-html quality/baseline/preview.html
combined_qa_procedure.behaviour: QH_JSDOM=<jsdom> node quality/lead/qh-jsdom-checks.mjs --html <preview> [--baseline quality/baseline/preview-nofonts.html --foundation-only <page built from the foundation patch alone>]  (J1-J17, J2b, J6b, J7b, R1-R9; J17 runs only with both extra pages; a candidate that renames a hook must say so so the check can be mapped)
combined_qa_procedure.audit: QH_PRIVATE_PROBES=<probe file kept outside the repository> PY -I -B quality/lead/qh-audit-fixtures.py <candidate producer folder>  (114 fixtures with the probes)
combined_qa_procedure.atlas: PY -I -B quality/lead/qh-atlas-fidelity.py <preview or atlas.json> [--html <preview>]  (AT0-AT8c: ids, enums, references, comparison agreement, edge uniqueness and labels, dependency-path connectivity, public safety of every value, rendering fidelity, text equivalent, editorial marking)
combined_qa_procedure.visual: VQ1-VQ7 (VISUAL-ATTACK.md), PIC-01..22 (attacks/R3-V-cycle3.yaml, -cycle3b.yaml, -cycle3c.yaml) and the inherited print, focus and phone checks, in root's primary native session on the matching account; this lane sends no browser connection request
combined_qa_procedure.external_gate: standalone single file; process/version language scan (audit warnings and Q05); closed-source path scan (Q04); C20 wording ruling from the content owner
combined_qa_procedure.status_contract: QH_JSDOM=<jsdom> node quality/lead/qh-status-extension.mjs --html <preview built from the final payload> [--status "refuted form"] [--word <a word from one of its hypotheses>]  (when the payload uses the status; otherwise on the builder fixture refuted-form)

atlas_expected: The 11:20 atlas (9 domains, 503 claims, 58 comparisons, 53 edges, 18 reading paths) is only the preserved layout baseline; the final atlas comes with the content owner's payload. The checker reads it from a data block or from the JSON, unchanged.

final_payload_checks.completeness: Every statement, question (decisive and frontier), example row, failure, open group, glossary entry and column of the payload is rendered: qh-static Q06, Q07 and Q10 counts equal the payload; Q09 finds every expected anchor.
final_payload_checks.stable_anchors: qh-static --baseline-html quality/baseline/preview.html: every anchor of the current page is present, or the content owner lists it as removed or renamed with its successor; an explicit id keeps the old anchor where a title changed (C19).
final_payload_checks.families_and_questions: Every family (row, domain or comparison in the payload) and every question has its own anchor and heading; the grid, the row list and any atlas view agree on counts and statuses (Q06, Q07, AT4).
final_payload_checks.relations_and_reading_paths: qh-atlas-fidelity.py on the final atlas data and the integrated page: AT0-AT5 on the data; AT8 every rendered relation is a payload edge with its label; AT8b a text equivalent lists every relation; AT8c every editorial reading path says so in visible text; dependency paths only where each step is an edge (AT6).
final_payload_checks.public_safety: Page audit 0 failures with the hardened audit; warnings reviewed by the content owner; external gate scans (Q04, Q05) and the closed-repository policy scan on the final page.
final_payload_checks.mathematics: Q08 and Q08-raw-tex: every TeX segment of every rendered field is MathML; 0 TeX errors; no \mathrm or \mathit group of letters and digits altered by the renderer (audit).
final_payload_checks.visual: root's primary native session, on the integrated page with the final payload; nothing is accepted from this lane's computed metrics alone.
final_payload_checks.payload_preconditions: Mathematics in TeX, not ASCII (C^1, v_4, E_1(z), not C1, v4, E1); no version token such as /v1 in an embedded data block; no \mathrm or \rm group with a letter followed by two or more digits; no internal LaTeX labels in formulas; SVG labels in the text form (E_8, C_2); original anchors persist for every kept item.

status_contract.refuted_form: Exact value 'refuted form' (with a space): a checked negative result in a stated scope; atlas code scoped_negative. Label page.json status_labels['refuted form'] (shared with cells), mark mark-refuted-form, card class st-refuted-form (colour token --st-refuted-form, solid border), data-status as written.
status_contract.hypotheses: Optional statement field: a list of non-empty texts (TeX and glossary terms allowed), rendered in order under the statement text as .statement-hypotheses with the label page.json labels.hypotheses (default 'Hypotheses'); searchable; anything else fails the build. A 'refuted form' statement without hypotheses builds with a warning (its scope is not stated).
status_contract.no_coercion: A statement status outside the list fails the build; a draft page shows it as written (class st-unknown), never as another status; counts skip it.
status_contract.consistency: Every status in use: counted in the tally with a link that opens the search on it; one row filter named by its label (?show=<status>, space encoded); a search facet; a row-mix entry with a visually hidden label; explained in the key (content status_key, else an audit warning).
status_contract.atlas_mapping: legacy statement status 'refuted form' corresponds to atlas status.code scoped_negative; other correspondences are the content owner's.
status_contract.tests: lead/qh-static.mjs Q06 (status as written, class, hypotheses, filters, key); lead/qh-status-extension.mjs S1-S6 on a page whose content uses the status (filter, address round trip, tally and facet, search in hypotheses, accessible names, no coercion); builder fixtures refuted-form, refuted-inexact, hypotheses-malformed, refuted-unscoped.
status_contract.cross_lane: Foundation (status.py, status.css, audit.py) and interaction (status.js) carry this delta in the guarded patch; a lane version that differs must keep the same vocabulary, field, labels and no-coercion rule.

integration_package.base: root's integration (foundation 695ff9a8; quality wrapper 7419f94a and audit 2e857726; baseline status.js) + foundation F1 9613254535445e7a… + F2 3f2c449364146401…
integration_package.status_language: labels by stored code per the content ruling (Established, Conditional, Remaining, Scoped negative; Published, Partial, Not posed, Proposed); carried by F1
